about: Reference examples for the realism study: 15 synthetic pages from documents NOT in the study pool, covering genuine pages in every capture (clean, JPEG, resized, scanned) and edited pages from every method (copy-move, re-typeset, PDF-source edit, AnyText, TextCtrl, UDiffText), from obvious to invisible, in a mixed order. No expected score: the admin (jiayu) rates them on the website (admin page, Reference examples) and those answers are the reference. Each page is described by several measures (score, clicks on/off the edit, outcome, edit visibility; study/outcome.py), not one score. The note says what was edited and what to look at. 'Save reference PDF' writes the PDF for the raters and data/stage2/practice/reference.json (shown to raters after each practice page). Candidates drawn with seed '20261006:training' (scripts/make_training.py --candidates), chosen and annotated by hand.

reference.note: Genuine page, clean digital copy. Nothing was edited.
Edited: the statement date. It is in a different typeface (no serifs) from the labels and the page number next to it, although it is well aligned.
Genuine page, scanned: slightly tilted and soft. The values are printed in a different typeface from the labels on the whole page; that is how this bank prints, not an edit.
Edited: the CIF number. Different typeface, larger and heavier than the date below, and the digits are badly formed.
Edited: the statement date, changed inside the PDF before the page was made. The new date matches the font, size and position exactly; there is no visible trace.
Edited: the day in the statement date (now "10"). Its "1" has a slightly different shape from the other digits on the line, which could also pass for the font.
Genuine page, scanned. Small oddities such as a stray hyphen in a product name or a slightly tilted line come from the document or the scan, not from an edit.
Edited: the month "Jul" in the period line. It is darker and heavier than the rest of the same line.
Edited: the first date of the period, by copying digits from elsewhere on the same page. The copied digits are the page's own, so there is no visible trace.
Edited: the name line. Its four words are in three different fonts, sizes and weights.
Edited: the upper amount (9,484.49). The new digits match well; at most a very slight difference in weight against the amount below.
Edited: the first word of the name line. Its letters (look at the two "I"s) are drawn a little differently, and it is set tighter than the number next to it.
Genuine page. The mixed text sizes in the address block are part of the bank's layout, not an edit.
Edited: the word "Divya" in the first sentence. It is lighter and thinner than the words around it.
Edited: the name before "SDN. BHD.". It is in a narrower, different typeface from the rest of the address block.

candidates.note: The account number was edited (one digit) and the change is invisible. Expected: 5. Not finding anything is normal for many edited pages.
The middle of the first address line was edited: thin, light, widely spaced letters with a broken join between two words. Expected: 1 with an edit click.
Genuine page, slightly compressed image. Bold and plain text mixed in one header line is the bank's layout. Expected: 5 (or 4).
The statement date was edited; it is very close to the original font. Expected: 4 or 5.
The second date of the period was edited: different, lighter typeface, a dot instead of a slash and a missing digit in the year. Expected: 1 with an edit click.
The postcode in the last address line was edited, invisibly. Expected: 5.
Genuine page, resized and compressed (slightly soft text). Softness that is the same over the whole page is not an edit. Expected: 5 (or 4).
The registration number after the bank name was edited, invisibly. Expected: 5.
The first word of the third address line ("SEREMBAN") was edited: taller, narrower and bolder than the rest of the line. Expected: 1 or 2 with an edit click.
